item.title: Obituary - Joseph Martin 'Joe' Conway
item.description: Joseph Martin “Joe” Conway, 78, passed away due to natural causes at Northern Montana Hospital on Thursday, August 7, 2025. Cremation has taken place, and a memorial service is pending. Holland & Bonine Funeral Home has been entrusted with arrangements. Please visit Joe’s online memorial page to send a card or leave a message of condolence for his family at https://www.hollandbonine.com ....

item.title: Montana Community Foundation Announces More Than $1 Million in Scholarships Available to Montana Students
item.description: Press release The Montana Community Foundation announced that more than $1 million in scholarships is available to Montana students.
